title: A quote's second line without ">" stays in the quote
head: 1943f58a0e9b6efa60a41afa2bbdfb06bcf9c492

clause.text: a line with no `>` right after a quoted line goes on with the quote's paragraph, as on GitHub: `> Never push to main` then `on a Friday.` is one quote, `Never push to main on a Friday.`

scenes.caption: A quote whose second line has no ">": both lines are the quote, "Never push to main on a Friday."

clause.text: a blank line or a new block ends the quote, as does a line after a quote that ends in code

scenes.caption: A blank line ends the quote, and so does code: the line after each is a paragraph of its own

clause.text: a quote nested deep renders at once

clauses.notShown: how long rendering takes has nothing to see on screen; tests/markdown.test.ts times it
